caseName: Humble Oil & Refining Co. v. Male, Commissioner, Department of Labor & Industry
caseNameFull: HUMBLE OIL & REFINING CO. v. MALE, COMMISSIONER, DEPARTMENT OF LABOR & INDUSTRY, NEW JERSEY
attorneys: T. Girard Wharton and John W. Fritz for appellants., Arthur J. Sills, Attorney General of New Jersey, and Theodore I. Botter, First Assistant Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
